coverage_statement: River uses 128 regenerated strategic roots over 64 representative final boards with exact parent-Turn/card lineage, transition labels, 20/60/100/150bb effective anchors, asymmetric covering stacks, pairedness, suit texture, connectivity, pot/SPR, action, position, posterior ranges, ties, folds, short calls, and all-in/uncalled returns. This is deliberately not a claim that the root bank enumerates all 2,598,960 physical five-card public boards.

range_feature_coverage.range_probability_model: exact sampled blocker-conditioned player marginal derived from the normalized compatible two-player joint action-posterior law
